title: Tolvi vault metadata
description: The .vault-meta.json marker file at the root of every Tolvi vault directory. A vault declares who it is; where its roots live is machine-local configuration and is never committed here.

workspace.description: The workspace this vault belongs to: the container, and the unit the server keys multi-tenant isolation on. Slug format: lowercase ASCII alphanumerics with single hyphens between them, never as the first or last character.

repo.description: The repo this vault belongs to: the member within the workspace. Optional. A container vault serves a whole workspace and names no repo. Slug format matches workspace.

product.description: The product whose repos share a vault root. Optional, and declared only where sibling repos genuinely share a brain. Slug format matches workspace.

embedding_model.description: The embedding model used to index this vault locally. Default value SHOULD be `nomic-embed-text` (Ollama).

schema_version.description: Tolvi vault format version. Version 2 replaced the visibility and private_vault routing fields with identity: repo and product. MUST be 2.
